intro.title: Workplace pension savings, end to end
intro.text: Léa Muller saves for her pension with Valoria Life, a fictional Luxembourg insurer, through her employer: the invitation, the advice, the due diligence, a year of payroll and the Art. 111bis tax deduction, live. Then seven colleagues, what the record recommends, and the dossier made from it.
points: One year of one member, live
The dossier, in HTML and PDF

outro.title: Off the shelf, under your own brand
outro.text: Seven workflows and one journey; agents under outcome contracts, people under a policy, every step in the record. Replace the reference adapters with your systems, put your brand in a DESIGN.md, and the views, the recommendations and the dossier follow.
points: Eight scenarios, tested in both SDKs

moments.caption: The questionnaire goes to the AI adviser, and the Risk profile table decides: balanced, risk indicator 4 at most.
The choice is checked against her profile: suitable, confirmed.
Identity documents read, screened against the PEP and sanctions lists, tax residence certified: standard due diligence.
The first premium is invested: goal “Policy issued”. Thirty days to cancel begin.
The Deduction rules table applies Art. 111bis LIR: up to 4,500 EUR a year per taxpayer from 2026.
Twelve premiums of 375 EUR: in January, Léa's 2026 tax certificate goes out.
She claimed the deduction in her tax return: goal “First year's deduction claimed”.

steps.caption: The Recommendations tab, computed from the same record: each change on a map of impact and effort.
One opened: why it fired, the customers behind it, the expected effect and how it is known.
Another is measured by replay: hand “Verify identity documents” to a person at the first failure.
Before and after, replayed on Ana's run with the AI recorded: one failed attempt fewer, the same person deciding, sooner.
Export dossier: the audience, the scope, the sections, the brand and the formats, checked for accessibility first.
The HTML edition is made here, in the browser, and waits for a person's approval; PDF and DOCX come from the command line.

Every sentence cites the journal records it rests on; no feeling the record does not state.
The analysis: where the days go; cost, quality, mood and trust.
What to change, in order: the recommendations with their owners, and the EU AI Act appendix.
